content:
We're hiring PhDs and postdocs to work on research projects associated with CSLib at FORM -- the Centre for Formal Methods and Future Computing, located at the Danish Institute of Advanced Study and University of Southern Denmark. Come work with us on formal computer science!

We have many possible projects connected or you can propose your own. Spreading the news is appreciated. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to me or any of the FORM investigators.

Deadline for applications: 16 August 2026

Links:

  • PhD call: https://fa-eosd-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/da/sites/CX_1001/job/4058/
  • Postdoc call: https://fa-eosd-saasfaprod1.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/da/sites/CX_1001/job/4076/
